name: aspern
description: Independent on-chain due diligence for DeFi vaults, the firms that run them, AI agents and tokenized real-world assets.

interface.longDescription: ASPERN reads DeFi vaults, AI agents and tokenized real-world assets directly from the chain and answers one question: what does the record actually show? Twenty-one read-only research tools. For vaults: what a vault holds, who can move the money, what depositors actually earned against the rate that was advertised, and what has actually been withdrawn. For AI agents: who has paid an agent, whether those payers are independent, how its jobs ended, and side-by-side comparisons. For real-world assets: tokenized stocks across issuers and networks, who issues and controls them, which agents moved them over a chosen window, how much stock a vault holds or lends against, and agent payments in stablecoins. Every answer states the population it was computed over and what it could not establish. ASPERN is research only: it does not sell anything, give investment advice, or move, transfer or trade money.
defaultPrompt: Use ASPERN to check the Grove x Steakhouse USDC vault on Base: who can move the money, and what did depositors actually earn?
Use ASPERN to find out how many AI agents moved tokenized Tesla or NVIDIA stock in the last 24 hours.
Use ASPERN to check this AI agent's record before I hire it: 0x601024e27f1c67b28209e24272ced8a31fc8151f

positive.description: Check one vault: control, earnings against the advertised rate, and what it cannot see
positive.prompt: Use ASPERN to check the Grove x Steakhouse USDC vault on Base. Who can move the money, and did depositors earn what was advertised?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the vault's record: who controls it, what a holder actually earned set against the advertised rate with the period that comparison rests on, the risk band, and the list of things ASPERN could not establish for this vault.

positive.description: Ask whether a given amount could leave a vault, from withdrawals that actually settled
positive.prompt: Using ASPERN, how much has actually been withdrawn from the Grove x Steakhouse USDC vault on Base over the last 30 days, and has a single withdrawal of $1 million ever cleared there?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns settled withdrawals over 7, 30 and 90 days with the index coverage, the largest single exit recorded with its date, the declared withdrawable level with its age, and for $1,000,000 what the last declared capacity says, stated as not a current confirmation.

positive.description: Check an AI agent's record from the public chain
positive.prompt: Use ASPERN to check the record of the AI agent at 0x601024e27f1c67b28209e24272ced8a31fc8151f. Who has paid it, and are those payers independent?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns who paid the agent, how many of those payers were never paid back by it, how concentrated its business is, its jobs where it works on Virtuals ACP, and when it was last paid, each with what it covers.

positive.description: Agents and a tokenized stock over a window
positive.prompt: With ASPERN, how many AI agents did something with tokenized NVIDIA stock in the last 24 hours?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns how many distinct agent addresses moved NVIDIA stock tokens over the window, their transfers in and out and value at the issuer's reference, by token and network, and which networks and agent kinds are covered.

positive.prompt: Use ASPERN to tell me how much tokenized stock the Steakhouse High Yield USDC vault on Base holds or lends against.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the vault, then returns the tokenized stocks it holds at its own address and what it has supplied to markets whose collateral is a stock token, saying that lending against stocks is exposure through borrowers, and whether the vault's own asset is a stablecoin.

positive.description: Who issues a tokenized stock and who controls it
positive.prompt: With ASPERN, who issues tokenized Tesla stock, on which networks, and is any address that controls those tokens on a sanctions list?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Tesla's stock tokens by issuer and network with what is in issue, then for an issuer returns its entity as its documents name it, the addresses that control its tokens and an exact-match sanctions screening of those addresses with the list date and its limits.

positive.description: Agent payments in stablecoins over a window
positive.prompt: According to ASPERN, how many agent payments in USDC were made over the last 7 days, and on which networks?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the number of payments, paying and receiving addresses over the window, by token and network, and states which payments are counted and when the figure was computed.

Investment advice is outside the plugin; it reports records and does not recommend

publication.release_notes: 1.0.3: research only, now also on AI agents and tokenized real-world assets. The plugin connects to https://aspern.org/mcp/chatgpt with twenty-one read-only tools: the ten vault tools of 1.0.2 (with clearer time and freshness on every reading), five tools on AI agents' public records (find, check, compare, a four-question hire check and a due-diligence report), and six on real-world assets (tokenized stocks by company, token and issuer with a sanctions screen of control addresses, agent activity with a stock over a chosen window, a vault's tokenized stocks and stablecoins, and agent stablecoin payments). No tool is paid, sells anything, gives advice, or moves, transfers or trades money.
